::: {.about-intro}
# Dimitrios Mallios

::: {.about-location}
📍 London, United Kingdom
:::

::: {.about-bio}
Dimitrios Mallios is a Machine Learning Engineer. He has a MEng in Computer Engineering and an MSc in Artificial Intelligence. 

He has built AI applications in the industry and academia spanning from computer vision and reccomendation systems to LLMs, Visual LLMS and agents. His main focus is to incubate new ideas and shape them into a product. He has published a variety number of papers and worked with open source projects.  

In his free time he loves reading about AI evolution and alignment with humans.

Connect with him on [LinkedIn]() and [X]().
